prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time of the collision in Pearland, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car. I was stopped at a red light on a main road when it happened.

Q: Can you describe what happened just before the impact?

A: I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I was completely stopped. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car lurched forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I checked my mirror a moment earlier, but I didn't see it coming. It hit me pretty hard.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, but my right wrist was really hurting. I was holding it against my chest when the officer arrived.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for your wrist?

A: Yes. I went to the emergency room that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me it was fractured. I had to get a splint and I was told I'd need to see a hand specialist.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Gripping things is hard, and I can't drive for long periods because my wrist aches. I'm still going to physical therapy a few times a week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm hoping to get back to work soon. I want this handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
